root_cause.text: The `fastrpc_get_args()` function incorrectly uses `find_vma()` to resolve a user-provided pointer, which can return a VMA that does not actually contain the pointer and cause an integer underflow when calculating the DMA address offset.
root_cause.evidence: The patch diff replaces `find_vma(current->mm, ctx->args[i].ptr)` with `vma_lookup(current->mm, ctx->args[i].ptr)` in `drivers/misc/fastrpc.c`. As explained in the commit message, when the pointer falls in a gap before the returned VMA, the calculation `(ptr & PAGE_MASK) - vma->vm_start` underflows, corrupting the DMA address sent to the DSP.
